bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 28000 Released - This update enhances overall experience with minor improvements for Canary Channel Insiders.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 26220.7070 Available - Dev & Beta Channels receive new features and improvements in this latest build.
New Side-Channel Attack Discovered - **Microsoft** reveals a novel attack on remote language models threatening user privacy.
Azure Ultra Disk Enhancements Announced - New features improve performance and cost efficiency for mission-critical workloads.
Microsoft Named Leader in IDC MarketScape - Recognition highlights **Microsoft's** commitment to secure enterprise browsing solutions.
Cloud Security Incidents on the Rise - IDC reports a significant increase in cloud security incidents, urging a shift in strategies.
AI Foundry and UiPath Transform Healthcare - New partnership automates workflows, improving efficiency and ROI in patient care.
AI's Dual Role in Cybersecurity - **Microsoft** explores how AI can enhance or undermine cybersecurity efforts.
New European Cybersecurity Regulations - **Microsoft** emphasizes the importance of compliance with Europe's risk-based regulations.
Sovereign Cloud Capabilities Expanded - **Microsoft** enhances its Sovereign Cloud offerings to meet regulatory demands.
